title: Auditing and Generating Synthetic Data with Controllable Trust Trade-offs
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical auditing framework to evaluate 'trust' dimensions such as fidelity, privacy, utility, fairness, and robustness in synthetic data. While fairness is an ethical principle, the evaluation is based on standard algorithmic metrics for bias and regulatory compliance rather than benchmarking religious beliefs, theology, or broader moral/ethical systems.
